course.title: Hazards and Disaster Management
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: On average, cyclones happen about 2 times a year in Bangladesh. The hardest hit regions are Dhaka, Khulna and Barisal. The most severe cyclone to make landfall in Bangladesh in the past 12 months was Sitrang. At least 9 people had died after Cyclone Sitrang slammed into Bangladesh’s southern coast, snapping communications and power links and destroying houses.
